videos.title: Wyatt Earp
videos.description: Wyatt reaches Dead River to buy the ghost town but teams with a lonely barkeep to drive out ruthless outlaws.

videos.title: Buckskin 2
videos.description: After the events of the first film, Eli Porter is asked to return to the cursed Buckskin woods in the hopes of finding a young lady who is wanted by rival tribes and business men alike in the west.

videos.title: Doc Holliday 2
videos.description: After the OK Coral shootout in Tombstone, Doc Holliday opens a small Faro Saloon in a remote town where he encounters Edward Bailey. When a Faro game goes wrong for Edward, he turns up missing and Doc Holliday finds himself on trial for his murder.

videos.title: Doc Holliday
videos.description: Lawman Wyatt Earp recruits Doc Holliday to help him hunt down the infamous Bridle brothers.

videos.title: Doc Holliday 3
videos.description: Doc Holliday retires to Colorado after a long battle with tuberculosis and finds himself in one final adventure to save a young man from ruthless outlaws.

videos.title: Woman Walks Ahead
videos.description: Based on a true story, this riveting western follows a headstrong New York widow (Jessica Chastain) as she journeys west to meet Sioux chief Sitting Bull, facing off with an army officer (Sam Rockwell) intent on war with Native Americans.

videos.title: Buckskin
videos.description: Set in 1820, a Texan fur trapper journeys into the mysterious Buckskin woods in the hopes of saving a lost boy.

videos.title: Christmas Mountain: The Story Of A Cowboy Angel
videos.description: Inspired by an angel, an old cowboy (Slim Pickens) helps a widow and her children during the blizzard of '88.

videos.title: Christmas on the Range
videos.description: Kendall has just one holiday wish: to keep the family ranch solvent, even though a callous neighbor wants her land.","large":"Despite constant threats from her ambitious neighbor, Kendall Riley fights heroically to save the family ranch. In a surprising turn of events, Clint McCree, a veterinarian and her neighbor's son, arrives on the scene to deliver a calf from a cow having trouble giving birth. Gradually, a romance blossoms, until her neighbor's henchmen scatter Kendall's herd and she wonders if Clint's concern is genuine or if he is part of his family's effort to sabotage her land.

videos.title: A Christmas Romance at the Roanoke Ranch
videos.description: Assigned to cover Roanoke Ranch, reporter Megan joins cowboy-lawyer Brad to save the nonprofit. Together, they find love and hope during the holiday season.","large":"In Christmas Romance at the Roanoke Ranch, TV reporter Megan Williams is thrilled to cover the inspiring story of Roanoke Ranch for Kids, a nonprofit organization that helps at-risk youth through equine therapy. However, her excitement turns to concern when she discovers that the ranch is on the brink of financial collapse. Determined to save it, Megan teams up with Brad, a charming lawyer by day and cowboy by night.

videos.title: Lonestar Christmas
videos.description: A single mom brings her daughters to her estranged father's Texas ranch for Christmas, where she finds love with a local restaurateur and begins to heal old wounds.

videos.title: Buckskin 2
videos.description: After the events of the first film, Eli Porter is asked to return to the cursed Buckskin woods in the hopes of finding a young lady who is wanted by rival tribes and business men alike in the west.

videos.title: Seraphim Falls
videos.description: In 1868 a determined hunter (Liam Neeson) and four hired gunmen relentlessly pursue an injured man (Pierce Brosnan) across Nevada.","large":"Gideon (Pierce Brosnan), a former Union officer, finds himself the prey of a manhunt led by Carver (Liam Neeson), Gideon's Civil-War nemesis. Carver blames Gideon for a horrible war crime and refuses to give up the chase until his vengeance is complete. Gideon, though wounded, manages to stay one step ahead of his pursuers, until he and his mortal enemy meet in a final inevitable showdown.

videos.title: Birthright Outlaw
videos.description: A daughter kidnapped. A hidden past revealed. A seemingly futile chance at rescue. Now, Rev. Jeremiah Jacobs and his wife Martha must overcome the lies of the past to find their Hope for the future.

videos.title: The Wide West
videos.description: 1907. A mysterious gambler aids a couple of Japanese sumo wrestlers, the local Judge and a beautiful store owner against ruthless outlaws who have attacked a small Californian town.

videos.title: Pinkerton
videos.description: Allan Pinkerton, founder of America's first detective agency, embarks on a mission to capture the notorious outlaw, Jesse James.

videos.title: Jesse James
videos.description: Jesse James and his brother Frank race to secure the family's buried gold as members of the James-Younger gang attempt to steal it.

videos.title: The Ballad Of Lefty Brown
videos.description: A merciless cowboy sets out on a dangerous journey across the frontier, determined to do whatever it takes to avenge his longtime partner's brutal murder in this thrilling, action-packed western.

videos.title: Slow West
videos.description: A bounty hunter (Michael Fassbender) keeps his true motive a secret from the naïve Scottish teenager (Kodi Smit-McPhee) he's offered to serve as bodyguard and guide while the youth searches for his beloved in 1800s Colorado.

videos.description: A relationship expert who struggles with love finds herself stuck on a ranch before Christmas with a rancher.","large":"When her station changes formats, Chicago radio personality Christina Campbell moves to New York with her longtime producer and best friend Aliyah. While passing through the small town of Cedar Grove, a horse in the middle of the road causes Christina to swerve into a lamppost! Her car will take a few days to repair, but luckily the horse's owner, Corey Henderson, offers her a free stay at his ranch, which specializes in equine-assisted therapy.
